notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.notes:
Hello Renovators!

Along with the development of your company, it is worth investing in the development and improvement of tools that will be used for renovation works. At any point in the game, you will be able to return to your sole proprietorship office and upgrade your tools with the money you earn. Thanks to better tools, you will complete work such as demolition of walls, painting, washing, etc., much faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/b35c4493940b741591003cadc3f3124c7c56c35f.png[/img]

It is also worth mentioning the acquisition of new levels of reputation. This will allow you to obtain new tools, equipment, or interior finishing materials. In Post Industrial Renovator, we will provide various tools to diversify the gameplay.

What equipment, in your opinion, will be needed most during the renovation? Let us know in the comments section below! In addition, we invite you to visit our other social media!

[url=https://discord.gg/MXGzYFPYTs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/9d64c27ae755cfe408406686962c30e879c88824.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.notes:
Welcome!

Escape rooms provide an unforgettable experience and are a great way to spend time. Each room is a different story embedded in a specific category, which can be selected according to the visitors' preferences. Themes can be criminals, adventure, or horror. In Post Industrial Renovator, When working on an escape room, you should take care of the variety of rooms offered and successfully arrange the puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/3bdf0ac5b64b36ecebc9c013920724e329792cdf.png[/img]

Themed rooms are specially arranged spaces, in which you will find movie decoration or dedicated items designed mainly to improve the quality of the game. Be creative and inventive and renovate the most innovative escape room this world has not seen before!

What is the most exciting category, in your opinion? Do you already have ideas for interesting puzzles? Let us know in the comments section below or the Discord!

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

If you decide to renovate an abandoned factory, it can be so problematic
that they are massive facilities. Therefore, to make your job easier and give you more planning freedom, we decided to use the spatial planning system in isometric projection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/80604b268280c0a006da59132d0820d8e8956428.gif[/img]

You will receive a map of the entire complex divided into segments. You click on the given part and choose what is created in a specific place. Don’t forget that the quest giver can choose what to put there. Of course, each segment must be appropriately developed. It will be an affordable functionality that will meet the expectations of every user. 

We are curious what you think, feel free to share your thoughts on Discord or in the comments section. See you in the next Devlog!

[url=https://discord.gg/fY4wWDR29v][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/0fa2804c64b9b08c9aef5c670517af9008c438cd.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.notes:
Do you need a business idea? How about turning an abandoned old factory into a beautiful modern hotel? In Post Industrial Renovator, you will have many opportunities to create something unique and one of a kind. The hotel can be quite a complicated endeavor, but being creative and eager to work will help you achieve your goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/9edddd595191ea779e6e43282cfc8a9fcb9d6de9.png[/img]

In the beginning, it is worth mentioning the hotel reception. It is a representative place and should present what your hotel is like. You can also easily place the logo of your institution or information boards where guests are currently located. Let’s not forget about the whole idea of an abandoned factory, and it is worth leaving a few characteristic places showing what the building was. It gives a distinctive atmosphere. 

When planning the floor scheme, consider how many rooms your hotel will offer guests. Will they all be of a similar standard, or will you opt for the basic and premium division? The apparent aspect should be bathrooms for tenants. A private toilet per room provides more comfort. Guests would also like to eat in an affordable place. Design one particular area for a stylish restaurant. For business visitors, conference rooms with appreciate media resources will be helpful. Everything is up to you by swimming pools, gyms, Wellness & SPA centers. 

There are plenty of ideas, and it is enough to implement them. Do you have any crazy renovation ideas? Be sure to share with us, you can also join our Discord and get carried away by fantasy.

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Imagine that you were commissioned to convert an old factory into a modern office with many amenities. Where to start and how to renovate? In today’s devlog we will answer these questions.

In the beginning, it is definitely worth considering the layout of each room. The schedule must be in line with the vision of the company that will work there. In addition to the main offices where employees spend most of their time, there should be access to at least one conference room. Important business meetings will be held there. Moreover, do not forget to add toilets for women and men. Comfort and hygiene in such a place are crucial. When it comes to comfort, how about dining areas and coffee points for employees? It is an addition that will improve working conditions. A great convenience would be a terrace with varied vegetation and a separate special zone for smokers.

Furthermore, the division into different departments should be considered in the initial planning phase, for example: human resources, IT specialists, marketing, etc. In Post Industrial, you have many options that will surely help you create a second home for you and your employees. Imagination is the only limit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/7d108c837a7047cec310fbc1fc0b8a690485e57e.png[/img]

Show your thoughts on what the perfect office should look like. Let us know in the comments what you would like to see in the next devlog. And do not forget to check our social media!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
Welcome to the next part of Post Industrial’s devlog! Have you ever wondered, what would it be like if you lived in a chemical or textile factory? Well, it’s becoming more and more popular these days. People decide to rent a space in such a place, they renovate it and live there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/424738e23e6cab547eb2e468b310ec84fef9b31d.png[/img]

The first domesticated halls appeared over 100 years ago in Paris and New York, the authors were representatives of artistic bohemia. You as renovators will be able to let your imaginations run wild, feel this atmosphere and create something completely your own. The concrete floor, bare bricks, and the coolness of steel pipes have an irresistible charm. If you are a fan of this style you definitely should play Post Industrial Renovator. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/c862e7738a300eab5daca01d61aa28d22e380395.png[/img]

Thank you very much for your attention. Please share in the comments, what kind of style is your favorite? We also invite you to join our discord and check other social media!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
As I told you last time, in the 2nd devlog I will tell you about what can be in renovated former factories. 

Bar/ restaurant/ cafe. It may not sound so obvious but there is a great potential in such places. Post industrial premises have an unique atmosphere which can suit best for fancy, modern restaurants. What is more, a lot of space is perfect for places which want to organise events and parties like weddings for example. 
Such a spot would be also great if you want to do cosy concerts, or stand-up nights. You can also adapt this as a local theater. Maybe you won’t see in this kind of places classics like Shakespears but it would be perfect for modern and alternative arts. 

Speaking about art, maybe you should consider an art gallery? Fancy ones where wine is served to every guest. Or maybe a museum? It would be a great idea to use old items which you found while renovating a factory. You can show the history of manufacturing something! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/5f3a3eaa5b422ad87c36dd884494dea0d44f02a9.png[/img]

Do you prefer something else? Then maybe try to make a modern museum of science? A place where kids and adults can interact with an exhibition? Trust me, such places are cool. 

You can also renovate it as a hotel or apartments. Where will be a sports center, wellness etc. 

Do you have any more ideas what can be in post industrial places? Tell us in the comments!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to Post Industrial’s devlogs!  

If you are wondering what post industrial means, let me explain. Paraphrasing definitions which can be found in the Internet, post industrialism is when the economy is no longer based on heavy industry but service industry like serving food, entertainment and so on. 

What is more, because of fast technology development, new, modern factories are made and at the same time the old ones are becoming useless. That makes an opportunity for businesses to adapt it as a new place where people can find some services. What kind of, you may ask. I will tell you about it in the next devlog! But don’t worry it’s not the end of this episode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40855443/38b63aa48f67717f6f5a2730580a48ffc5410553.png[/img]

There are plenty of types of factories which can be renovated as for example chemical, food, textiles, furniture factories and many more. As abandoned, they can be devastated and full of trash. But sometimes in this trash you may find a real treasure. Old and broken things might not be worth so much but if you find something interesting you may try to renovate this. Fixed and refreshed items can be used to decorate the space you renovate. It can add some unique atmosphere to that place and be a connection between new and old life of this location. What is more, it could be very useful if you plan to make a museum because you can use it as a museum object! 

That’s all for today. Hope you like that. Don’t forget to join our Discord because we add there special posts about post industrial places worth visiting! If you have any suggestions about the topic of the next devlog, feel free to tell us in the comments!
